svg.title: Pass the Phone Discovery Handoff Journeys (Zero Dead Ends · Era 3)
svg.desc: End-to-end household journey map covering Settings opt-in and primary couch handoff for kids aged 4 to 12, sibling turn via 1-tap parent return and converged return, early kid exit with confirmation and reload/deleted-origin safety, and fast last-swipe vote attribution with selection/return failure recovery.
svg.text: WFS / Shared Table · Family Cookbook Era 3 · End-to-End Journeys
Pass the Phone Journeys — Opt-In, Kid Turn (4–12) & Calm Return
Clean voting screens for everyone, one-device opt-in, pure celebration wrap-up, single dock exit, and calm closure.
